V-M-KERNEL-DESCRIBE.Scenario: Capability descriptions carry their ref, effect, schemas, implementation state, exposure and a contract digest; Locus descriptions carry decoded properties, sorted capabilities, derived incoming relations, archetype rules, diagnostics and a digest; the model description follows model order with a digest over the Locus digests; verification descriptions are not-run without a report and never verified without a passed finding; input fields are derived from descriptions with $ref resolution; text is coerced to input values with the contract edge cases.
V-M-KERNEL-DESCRIBE.TraceAssertion: describe.test.ts names the describeCapability, describeLocus, describeModel and describeVerifications tests, including the digest, knowledge and freezing checks; fields.test.ts names the inputFields and coerceInput tests.

V-M-KERNEL-INVOKE.Scenario: A capability runs only for its own Locus or a valid granting relation; each invocation error tag (LocusNotFound, CapabilityNotFound, NotGranted, InvalidInput, NotImplemented, Defect, InvalidOutput, and declared handler errors) is returned as a value with the contract message; invalid input never reaches the handler; a successful call returns the encoded output.
V-M-KERNEL-INVOKE.TraceAssertion: invoke.test.ts names the isGranted tests and one invoke outcome test per error tag, plus the success, handler-skipping and handler-count tests.
